register.labelZh: DIG 片語動詞的實際用途
register.summaryZh: DIG 片語動詞可以用來請人開始吃東西,也可以表示某人充滿幹勁地投入工作。；你可以用 DIG 表達找出舊物、從積雪或泥土中挖出事物,以及把地下的東西挖出來。；DIG 可以描述爪、腳跟或尖端牢牢抓進或插進某個表面。；這些表達可見於飲食對話、工作情境、工程、戶外故事,以及描述掩護位置的報道。
register.summaryEn: DIG expressions let you invite people to start eating and show that someone begins a task with energy. You can use DIG to talk about finding an old item, freeing something from snow or earth, and uncovering something buried. DIG can describe claws, heels or a sharp point pressing firmly into a surface. These expressions appear in food talk, work situations, building work, outdoor stories and reports about protected positions.
